Below is a concise overview of the core modules currently deployed in our platform, along with their identifiers, display order, and associated icon classes.

- Module 1 (Alpha) – ID 1, order 10, icon fa-user-shield: Primary module handling user authentication and session management.  
- Module 2 (Beta) – ID 2, order 20, icon fa-chart-line: Analytics service aggregating real-time metrics and generating reports.  
- Module 3 (Gamma) – ID 3, order 30, icon fa-bell: Notification system delivering email and push alerts to end users.
